newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Luk Fook public offering 110 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Luk Fook public offering 110 times subscribed.

text.p: Jewellery manufacturer and retailer Luk Fook Holdings (International) Ltd said on Tuesday its initial public offering of shares in Hong Kong was 110 times oversubscribed.
Luk Fook offered 114 million shares, together with warrants in the proportion of one warrant for every five shares subscribed, at HK$1.00 per share.
Shares available to employees and its subsidiaries were also fully subscribed, the company said in a statement.
Dealing in the shares and warrants is expected to begin on May 6, it said.

Luk Fook and its subsidiaries are principally engaged in the sourcing, retailing and wholesale distribution of a variety of gold jewellery and gold ornaments, gem-set jewellery, gemstones and other accessory items in Hong Kong.
It operates 12 retail outlets in Hong Kong.
